SRFTI students demand safety, action after clash ahead of rally

Students at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) have maintained an 'academic boycott' and are demanding the arrest of individuals involved in a recent clash. The students' union has also urged for safety measures to be implemented ahead of a planned rally by the Hindu Jagran Manch. The specific details of the clash and the individuals responsible have not been detailed in the coverage.
